title: Cognitive overload and rest dataset. Simultaneous EEG + PPG + ECG + eye-tracking
description: This dataset contains raw 64-channel EEG recorded simultaneously with electrocardiography, photoplethysmography, eye-tracking/pupillometry and behavioral data from 124 healthy young adults. Recordings cover a resting-state session (alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open blocks followed by passive cartoon viewing) and an adaptive verbal working memory digit-span task with serial recall. The dataset supports research on cognitive load, working memory and psychophysiological markers of overload and rest.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 64-channel Brain Products system, with ECG and PPG recorded via the amplifier's AUX channels. Eye-tracking and pupillometry were recorded with a Pupil Labs Core wearable eye-tracker. In the adaptive digit-span task, sequence length increased when 7 or more of 10 trials in a block were recalled correctly and decreased otherwise. Participants typed responses on a numpad.
